title: docs(skills): record-page rule names drawer and full page as the reader's Open records choices

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCFvAws9PJHw556qFuw9stX)_

Fixes #29110

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`objectstack-ui` 技能的记录页规则第 6 条与评测第 2 题,把读者的「打开记录」选项改为抽屉(默认)或整页两种,并写明列表旁的分栏已退役。
- **为什么改**:控制台已退役列表旁分栏、默认改为抽屉打开;技能仍教「分栏为默认」,会让 AI 向作者描述一个已不存在的选项。
- **风险与回滚**:只改发布技能的两段文字与一份 patch changeset,无代码与契约改动;回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md` 第 6 条(47–53 行);`skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json` 第 2 题 `expected_output`。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期 record-page.md 为 996 tokens(上限 996)且退出码 0。
- **需要你做的**:审阅后批准(本 PR 改动 `skills/**`,需授权审批人批准方可落地)。

## What changes

The console retired the split pane beside the list (#28915, landed as ea150b7f): a list record opens in the drawer (the default) or as the full page, and the Display menu's Open records offers Drawer and Full page only. The shipped `objectstack-ui` skill still taught the old model.

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md` rule 6: Open records now reads "drawer — the default — or full page, for a drawer-mode object; the split beside the list is retired". The rest of rule 6 is checked against main's console code and kept: the right-column switch (`RECORD_RELATED_COLUMN_PREFERENCE`), the related panels' order and hidden set (`RECORD_RELATED_ARRANGEMENT_PREFERENCE`), and the drag-resize width and maximize button, which live on the record drawer (`navigation-overlay.tsx` `useDrawerResize`, `maximizable`). One more word changed with it: "the pane's dragged width and ⤢" now says "the drawer's", since the drawer is the only pane left.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json` eval 2: the prompt is unchanged (reps still ask for records beside the list). The expected answer now says a pane beside the list is no longer offered, that Open records is drawer (the default) or full page, kept in the browser, and that nothing is authored for it; `navigation: { mode: 'page' }` stays the one declaration. The assertions stay as they are and still hold: `must_contain` (`navigation: { mode: 'page' }`, `Display menu`) are both in the new text, and the `must_not_contain` entries are absent.
- `.changeset/29110-record-page-skill-split-retired.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch (`skills/` ships in that package's `files`).

Other skill text: a grep of `skills/` for "split beside", "beside the list", "Open records" and "split pane" found only these two files. No other skill text changes.

## Tests

No ui test is owed (text only). The skill gates the repo derives for this diff are listed under Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- `skills/` line readings. Changed file: `record-page.md` 65 lines before, 65 after (3981 bytes before, 3982 after; 996 tokens before and after, ceiling 996). The eval file is an eval fixture, measured and not ratcheted: 1899 bytes before, 1972 after. Whole package (sum of every `SKILL.md`): 4550 lines before and after; no `SKILL.md` is touched.
- The rule file sits at its token ceiling, so the new words were paid for inside the same sentence; no ceiling moved.
